# SIP-01 Search

> Static, serverless search client for the SIP-01 decentralized web index (Nostr kind 39697). No backend, no API key, no login — the page queries public relays directly from the browser and verifies every observation against the canonical protocol logic before showing it.

## Machine-readable search

- `/?q=<query>&format=json` — runs the search and returns a JSON document: `{ version, query, complete, pending, relays, generatedAt, documents, observations, dropped, results[] }`. Requires a JavaScript-capable reader (browser automation); re-read while `complete` is false.

## Agent instructions

- `agent/SKILL.md` — drop-in instructions for AI agents (search via the JSON view or a direct relay REQ, verification rules).

- Protocol: https://github.com/SIP-01/SIP-01
